answer: Each agent locks bonded stake and proves Semaphore membership while evaluating the epoch polynomial that binds its RLN identity to a rate limit. A river, beacon, or shale-themed message carries an epoch-scoped nullifier; repeating it with distinct messages exposes Shamir shares of the secret. Anyone can interpolate the private key from those shares, verify the violation, and trigger immediate, deterministic slashing of the agent’s collateral, making Sybil identities costly rather than free.
